tasks.short: Prepare appropriate classroom assignments for assistants or volunteers.

steps.what: Review actual pupil support needs and planned classroom activities
Choose suitable assistant or volunteer duties considering capability, boundaries and supervision
inputs: actual assistant availability and authorised duties

steps.what: Lay out selected assignments using the native classroom duty template
Write and check actual instructions, pupil-information limits and supervision arrangements
Save the checked final classroom assignments
Send the checked final assignments to their actual internal assistant or volunteer recipients

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} duty template for the teachers chosen assignment structure and recurring headings. Keep pupil needs, suitability judgement, actual instruction writing and information-access checking human; save and internally send the completed checked assignments as separate actions with no routine-action saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring assignment structure may be recreated for each classroom activity.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse approved headings without choosing people or inferring capability.
tasks.still_hard: Volunteers and assistants differ in actual experience, authority and supervision needs.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges which duties support pupils safely and what information each helper needs.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated layout; assignment and supervision responsibility stays with the teacher.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates can reuse duty headings and layouts for human-selected classroom assignments.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing and delivering assignments to internal classroom helpers, not their teaching work or subsequent supervision.

The teacher checks activity and pupil needs in s1 and enters actual selected duties, helper identity, timing, supervision and information limits in s2 and s4. No structured needs or suitability score is assumed.
Only repeated layout changes; all actual instruction writing and recipient checks retain full effort. If a native duty template already exists, no new benefit is claimed.

Shares are provisional. The existing instruction accuracy and audience check in s4 covers exact final actions, without a separate approval ceremony. The two fully retained 1 percent actions are schema granularity.
research_questions: Does a native duty template remove actual repeated layout while preserving individual instructions and audience limits?

incremental.description: Maintain duty headings and access guidance

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final assistant assignments and restricted document access
s4 exact final assignment instructions with actual internal helper recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native layout reduces 20 units by half, saving ten points minus 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Half eligible layout gives 4.5. Pupil review, duty choice, actual instructions, save and send retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Control classroom equipment and supplies inventory and actual distribution.

steps.what: Count actual classroom equipment and supplies and inspect condition
Enter and check actual item counts, usable condition and storage locations
Calculate available usable stock and display explicit shortfalls against planned classroom needs
Decide appropriate distribution considering activity needs, suitability and actual item condition
Physically distribute the selected equipment, materials or supplies to the classroom activity
Write and check actual issued quantities, destinations and remaining-stock corrections
Save the checked actual classroom distribution entry

tasks.design: Configure native formulas and a stock view in the existing {SPREADSHEET} from separately checked actual counts and planned quantities. Keep counting, condition judgement, distribution choice, physical issue and actual issue-entry writing human; save the checked update separately without silently placing a purchase order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Available usable stock and planned needs may be compared repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spreadsheet formulas can compare explicit quantities without deciding suitability or observing actual issues.
tasks.still_hard: Broken, missing or unsuitable classroom items still require direct examination.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher chooses appropriate materials for actual pupils and activities.
tasks.altitude: Less stock arithmetic; classroom resource and purchase authority do not change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spreadsheet formulas can compare checked usable stock counts with explicit planned quantities.

assumptions: Boundary covers actual classroom stock control and distribution, not buying supplies or evaluating pupils.

The teacher counts actual items in s1 and captures item ID, quantity, unit, usable condition and location in s2. Existing activity planning supplies needed quantities, which the teacher checks in s2; missing entries are completed manually there.
Actual issue quantities and destinations are captured only after physical distribution in s6; a chosen distribution never counts as an actual stock movement.

Shares and reduction are provisional for a classroom that actually compares quantities manually. Test native formulas first; existing formulas earn no benefit. The final entry accuracy check covers its fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
unknowns: Existing classroom stock records and formulas
Whether all items warrant quantity tracking
research_questions: Does the actual classroom inventory contain repeated arithmetic substantial enough to justify a maintained view?

incremental.description: Maintain item units and inspect stock-formula exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s6 complete checked actual distribution entry with quantities destinations and stock corrections

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional repeated stock comparison saves 20 points minus 1.5 upkeep = 18.5. Half eligible comparisons gives ten minus 1.5 = 8.5. Counting, input capture, judgement, physical distribution, actual issue writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated assignment layout and stock comparison; pupil-support and helper-supervision decisions remain human.
skills_to_grow: Keep assistant instructions appropriate to actual duties and access
Validate actual stock units and issue records
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who prepares clear helper duties and reliable classroom resource information while retaining actual pupil judgement.
